scope: Primary and authoritative sources for a defensive LWE scheduler study; no deployed-key attack authorization.

sources.title: FIPS 203: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard
supports: implementation conformance is not a complete security guarantee

sources.title: FIPS 204: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard
supports: ML-DSA has a signature role distinct from ML-KEM
key pairs are restricted to their intended purpose

sources.title: SALSA: Attacking Lattice Cryptography with Transformers
supports: learned recovery on selected small and sparse-secret LWE regimes

sources.title: PICANTE: Private Key Recovery in LWE Based Cryptosystems Using Deep Learning
supports: lattice preprocessing can expose signal for neural recovery of sparse binary secrets
does_not_support: a break of standardized ML-KEM parameters

sources.title: SALSA VERDE
supports: learned attacks extend to selected sparse binary, ternary, and narrow-Gaussian LWE secrets

sources.title: Benchmarking Attacks on Learning with Errors
sources.authority: authors and IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy paper
supports: common-cost comparison of neural, primal, dual, and hybrid attacks
recovery results for very sparse secrets at Kyber-like dimensions
does_not_support: recovery of ordinary full ML-KEM secret distributions
sources.license_note: The linked research code is CC-BY-NC; review before any commercial reuse.

sources.title: LWE Estimator
supports: standard estimated-cost baselines for LWE attacks

sources.title: Cool and Cruel is Dual
supports: comparison of variance-based sparse-secret attacks with known dual and primal methods

sources.title: KyberSlash
supports: practical timing leakage from secret-dependent divisions in affected Kyber implementations

sources.title: Fault attacks on Keccak-based ML-KEM and ML-DSA implementations
supports: fault-injection risk at implementation and control-flow boundaries

sources.title: Power side-channel analysis of Kyber implementations
supports: removing timing variation does not automatically remove physical leakage
